business_overview.one_sentence: The group manufactures and sells displays and related modules, including LCDs, LCMs, TFTs and CTPs, while beginning AI compute related business investment.

segments.name: Displays and other services
segments.business_substance: Single reportable segment covering displays and other services.
segments.source: Annual Report 2024/25, note 6 segment information, text lines 4040-4160

business_overview.revenue_model: Point-in-time product sales of display components and modules; 2025 product revenue included LCD HK$163.457m, LCM HK$367.694m, TFT HK$175.722m, CTP HK$289.316m and other services HK$42.346m.
business_notes: Management stated AI compute and related business revenue remained insignificant in FY2025, while related equipment capital expenditure increased.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Non-recurring gain from disposal and deemed disposal of Nantong Jianghai.
non_recurring_items.source: Annual Report 2024/25, consolidated profit or loss and MD&A, text lines 2320-2485 and 312-405

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Fair value loss mainly from the retained Nantong Jianghai interest.
non_recurring_items.source: Annual Report 2024/25, note 25 and MD&A, text lines 5330-5435 and 312-405

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Equity-accounted associate profit, not direct operating cash from the display business.
non_recurring_items.source: Annual Report 2024/25, consolidated profit or loss and note 19, text lines 2320-2485 and 4760-4965

funds_assets.business_substance: Bank balances and cash, including short-term bank deposits with original maturity of three months or less.
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2024/25, statement of financial position and note 24, text lines 2320-2485 and 5330-5435

operating_assets.business_substance: Raw materials, work in progress and finished goods for display products.
Trade receivables, other receivables, deposits and prepayments; trade credit periods range from 30 to 150 days.
Manufacturing and AI compute related equipment assets.
operating_assets.source: Annual Report 2024/25, statement of financial position, text lines 2320-2485

investment_assets.business_substance: Includes PRC listed Nantong Jianghai shares at HK$2.589bn and PRC unlisted strategic investments.
28.08% listed PRC associate carried by equity method; fair value disclosed as HK$1.094bn.
Speculative grade listed bonds with maturities from June 2028 to September 2029.
Hong Kong investment properties with disclosed fair value; carrying value is HK$0.372m.

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Unsecured bank borrowings repayable within one year.
Capitalised leases for rented premises and motor vehicles.
financing_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2024/25, notes 17 and 30, text lines 4760-4965 and 5570-5625

operating_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2024/25, statement of financial position, text lines 2320-2485

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Customer contract liabilities related to product/service delivery.
operating_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2024/25, statement of financial position, text lines 2320-2485

other_liabilities.business_substance: Deferred tax liabilities, materially affected by PRC withholding tax on undistributed profits and disposal-related items.
other_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2024/25, statement of financial position and note 10, text lines 2485-2565 and 4250-4385

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: FY2025 reported profit is dominated by a non-recurring associate disposal gain. Operating cash flow fell to HK$14.518m while capital expenditure rose to about HK$151m, mainly for AI compute related equipment; distributable cash profit is materially below reported profit.

gaps: The annual report does not split group cash by listed parent, Hong Kong subsidiaries, PRC subsidiaries and other subsidiaries; cash detachability uses a conservative group-level haircut.
Only FY2024 and FY2025 operating cash flow and capital expenditure were extracted from the 2024/25 annual report; a full three-year cash conversion table was not available from this single filing.
No lock-up, disposal tax basis or post-period market value was independently verified for the retained Nantong Jianghai shares or Suzhou QingYue stake in this run.
